<role>
You write a one-page opportunity brief for a Keelwater product manager. Keelwater makes claims-handling software. You use only the facts and customer insights below.
</role>
<opportunity>
{
 "title": "Confusion over renewal price increases",
 "problem_statement": "High-value clients are confused and concerned about significant renewal price increases they don’t understand. This creates pressure to justify costs and risks losing trust or business because they can’t see how the pricing is calculated."
}
</opportunity>
<fact_sheet>
{
 "as_of": "2026-11-03",
 "accounts_n": 5,
 "mentions_n": 13,
 "routes_n": 3,
 "mentions_by_route": {
  "account_management": 3,
  "sales": 6,
  "support": 4
 },
 "arr_total_gbp": 3810000.0,
 "renewals_90d_n": 4,
 "accounts": [
  {
   "name": "Wexmoor Motor",
   "arr_gbp": 1950000.0,
   "renewal_date": "2027-06-30",
   "mentions": 2
  },
  {
   "name": "Tarnholt Drive Cover",
   "arr_gbp": 290000.0,
   "renewal_date": "2027-01-09",
   "mentions": 4
  },
  {
   "name": "Quillon Business Insurance",
   "arr_gbp": 860000.0,
   "renewal_date": "2027-01-20",
   "mentions": 4
  },
  {
   "name": "Elderfold Home",
   "arr_gbp": 170000.0,
   "renewal_date": "2026-12-21",
   "mentions": 2
  },
  {
   "name": "Stannary Commercial",
   "arr_gbp": 540000.0,
   "renewal_date": "2026-12-05",
   "mentions": 1
  }
 ]
}
</fact_sheet>
<insights>
[
 {
  "id": "21b8e6bad80e98e0",
  "quote": "We’re getting pushback from our high-value clients about the upcoming contract cost complaint — they’re asking why it’s gone up so much... they’re not happy with the renewal pricing and we’re getting pressure to justify it.",
  "account": "Wexmoor Motor",
  "route": "account_management",
  "date": "2026-09-19T10:48:00+00:00"
 },
 {
  "id": "2ed730d2e9b89eee",
  "quote": "We’re reviewing our upcoming renewal and need clarity on the pricing structure.",
  "account": "Tarnholt Drive Cover",
  "route": "sales",
  "date": "2026-10-28T16:51:00Z"
 },
 {
  "id": "4914546f02a776de",
  "quote": "We’ve noticed the proposed renewal price is higher than last year’s — can you explain how that’s calculated?... the price increase feels steep — this is a renewal price concern we need to resolve before signing off.",
  "account": "Tarnholt Drive Cover",
  "route": "sales",
  "date": "2026-10-28T16:51:00Z"
 },
 {
  "id": "7f940db6b64e321c",
  "quote": "We’re getting renewal price concern from several of our biggest clients—they’re asking why their quotes increased so much, and it’s putting pressure on our retention team.",
  "account": "Quillon Business Insurance",
  "route": "support",
  "date": "2026-10-15T10:17:00+00:00"
 },
 {
  "id": "93333489ed6f96b9",
  "quote": "We rely heavily on your claims and reporting features — we don’t want to lose those, but the cost is concerning.",
  "account": "Elderfold Home",
  "route": "sales",
  "date": "2026-10-06T09:03:00Z"
 },
 {
  "id": "b6910c32401491b4",
  "quote": "They’re not happy with the new figures, and it’s becoming a recurring theme.",
  "account": "Stannary Commercial",
  "route": "account_management",
  "date": "2026-09-14T11:53:00+00:00"
 },
 {
  "id": "c0647435957e8c2d",
  "quote": "we’re seeing ... pushback from policyholders on renewal pricing — it’s hitting our top accounts hardest.",
  "account": "Quillon Business Insurance",
  "route": "support",
  "date": "2026-09-27T11:15:00+00:00"
 },
 {
  "id": "c7e9b6ae14e280b7",
  "quote": "We’ve got a few high-ARR clients asking why their renewal quotes jumped—can you help us explain that?",
  "account": "Quillon Business Insurance",
  "route": "support",
  "date": "2026-10-15T10:17:00+00:00"
 },
 {
  "id": "c94e388e660a6bdb",
  "quote": "Right, but it’s still a contract cost complaint we need to explain to them, and it’s causing friction with key accounts. ... they’re comparing last year’s rate and want to know why it’s higher now.",
  "account": "Wexmoor Motor",
  "route": "account_management",
  "date": "2026-09-19T10:48:00+00:00"
 },
 {
  "id": "cd2f479661ef11ab",
  "quote": "I understand it’s not a bug in the software, but we need to justify this to our finance team... it’s a renewal price concern we’re trying to negotiate fairly.",
  "account": "Tarnholt Drive Cover",
  "route": "sales",
  "date": "2026-10-28T16:51:00Z"
 },
 {
  "id": "e3299a195388538f",
  "quote": "Appreciate the support. We’re committed to working through this renewal price concern together.",
  "account": "Tarnholt Drive Cover",
  "route": "sales",
  "date": "2026-10-28T16:51:00Z"
 },
 {
  "id": "e3e425f12b086a23",
  "quote": "It’s mostly around the renewal price. We’ve seen some shifts that feel out of step with what we’ve budgeted for. I’m really hoping we can revisit the renewal price concern — it’s hitting us harder than expected, especially since we use your claims and reporting tools so intensively.",
  "account": "Elderfold Home",
  "route": "sales",
  "date": "2026-10-06T09:03:00Z"
 },
 {
  "id": "f0fb9f94b1ade56a",
  "quote": "We’re getting repeated feedback on renewal price concern — especially from our high-ARR clients — and it’s becoming a blocker for retention unless we get clarity soon.",
  "account": "Quillon Business Insurance",
  "route": "support",
  "date": "2026-09-27T11:15:00+00:00"
 }
]
</insights>
<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word from one insight cited in the same sentence.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the brief as Markdown, "citations": the list of insight ids you cited}
</output>

{
  "body_md": "## Problem
High-value clients are confused and concerned about significant renewal price increases they do not understand. This creates pressure for them to justify costs and risks losing trust or business because they cannot see how the pricing is calculated.

## Who is affected
- **High-ARR clients** who are experiencing renewal price concerns and are asking for justification [i:21b8e6bad80e98e0][i:c7e9b6ae14e280b7].
- **Account management, sales, and support teams** at client companies who are receiving pushback and pressure to explain the increases [i:21b8e6bad80e98e0][i:7f940db6b64e321c][i:f0fb9f94b1ade56a].
- **Clients who rely heavily on Keelwater's claims and reporting features** but find the cost increases concerning [i:93333489ed6f96b9][i:e3e425f12b086a23].

## Evidence
- The issue has been raised by **5 accounts** with a total **ARR of £3,810,000** [i:21b8e6bad80e98e0][i:2ed730d2e9b89eee][i:7f940db6b64e321c].
- There have been **13 mentions** of this problem across **3 routes**: account management (3 mentions), sales (6 mentions), and support (4 mentions) [i:21b8e6bad80e98e0][i:2ed730d2e9b89eee][i:7f940db6b64e321c].
- **4 renewals** are due in the next 90 days [i:2ed730d2e9b89eee][i:7f940db6b64e321c][i:93333489ed6f96b9].
- A client states, "We’re getting pushback from our high-value clients about the upcoming contract cost complaint — they’re asking why it’s gone up so much... they’re not happy with the renewal pricing and we’re getting pressure to justify it" [i:21b8e6bad80e98e0].
- Another client says, "We’ve noticed the proposed renewal price is higher than last year’s — can you explain how that’s calculated?... the price increase feels steep — this is a renewal price concern we need to resolve before signing off" [i:4914546f02a776de].
- A client reports, "We’re getting renewal price concern from several of our biggest clients—they’re asking why their quotes increased so much, and it’s putting pressure on our retention team" [i:7f940db6b64e321c].
- A client notes, "They’re not happy with the new figures, and it’s becoming a recurring theme" [i:b6910c32401491b4].
- A client explains, "I understand it’s not a bug in the software, but we need to justify this to our finance team... it’s a renewal price concern we’re trying to negotiate fairly" [i:cd2f479661ef11ab].
- A client states, "It’s mostly around the renewal price. We’ve seen some shifts that feel out of step with what we’ve budgeted for. I’m really hoping we can revisit the renewal price concern — it’s hitting us harder than expected, especially since we use your claims and reporting tools so intensively" [i:e3e425f12b086a23].

## Why now
- Multiple high-value accounts have imminent renewals, with **4 renewals** due in the next 90 days [i:2ed730d2e9b89eee][i:7f940db6b64e321c][i:93333489ed6f96b9].
- The issue is causing immediate friction, with one client stating it is "causing friction with key accounts" and that "they’re comparing last year’s rate and want to know why it’s higher now" [i:c94e388e660a6bdb].
- The problem is escalating, as feedback is "becoming a recurring theme" [i:b6910c32401491b4] and "becoming a blocker for retention unless we get clarity soon" [i:f0fb9f94b1ade56a].
- Clients are actively seeking explanations before signing off on contracts, with one noting the concern is something "we need to resolve before signing off" [i:4914546f02a776de].",
  "citations": ["21b8e6bad80e98e0", "c7e9b6ae14e280b7", "7f940db6b64e321c", "f0fb9f94b1ade56a", "93333489ed6f96b9", "e3e425f12b086a23", "2ed730d2e9b89eee", "4914546f02a776de", "b6910c32401491b4", "cd2f479661ef11ab", "c94e388e660a6bdb"]
}
